summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 20, 2026, announcing assay results from four diamond drill holes at the Ramp Zone of the Apollo deposit, Guayabales Project, Caldas, Colombia. Holes APC164-D3 and APC164-D4 stepped out roughly 340 meters along the previously undrilled northwestern breccia margin, returning 54.00 m @ 2.84 g/t AuEq and 12.10 m @ 11.33 g/t AuEq respectively, plus new high-grade veins; assays are pending for 95 holes. The filing is a routine exploration update, not a special situation.
